name: Onboarding Tour — sidebar entry opens the repo's tour page
description: AC-1 of specs/2026-10-01-onboarding-generator.md. From the sidebar's WORKSPACE group, Onboarding Tour opens /repos/:repoId/tour for the active repo and the page renders its crumb title. The seeded repo has no stored tour, so the page is in its empty state (EC-1); the flow deliberately never clicks Generate, so no model call is made. Rendering, copy and error states are covered by the client component tests and server/test/onboarding.it.test.ts. The Add repository screen at /onboarding stays covered by 06-onboarding.flow.json (NFR-10). Read-only. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (guaranteed by e2e-web.yml).

steps.label: root redirects to the seeded repo's PR list
repos fetch settles so the sidebar links carry the repo id
the sidebar WORKSPACE group lists an Onboarding Tour entry (nav.ts)
open Onboarding Tour from the sidebar
